script.source: GOB 466 uses ViralDOT, with type 2, duration 15 s and update interval 2.5 s. tempmods.py ViralDOT applies the rounded tick and VIRUSCRASH_FX.
script.runtime: TempMods.DotTick, TimedEffects.Active.TickDamage and PlayerEffects/MobEffects.Ticked dispatch the periodic typed damage and tick FX.
script.test: AbilityTargetTests.PlagueZoneIsDamageOverTime checks zero direct damage, exact rounding and tick FX. stats.source: GOB 1102 self-cast non-toggle and its sole indefinite stat 575 modifier, function 2 at scale 3.0.
stats.runtime: AbilityScaledBuffs.TryToggle resolves effective learned rank and preserves the non-toggle flag; AbilityBuffs applies/removes the snapshot and AbilityControlDurations consumes the resulting stat total.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.CapturedStatusBuffsFeedDefenseAccuracyAndDeterminationConsumers tests mitigation and removal; the rank-20 case checks +60, non-toggle semantics and immediate reuse timer. ability-status verifies the +150 wire modifier at rank 50; stock Status displayed the same +150 on refresh. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/315#issuecomment-6999207958
